hostile_input_contract.structural_representation: Deterministic layered exact-count transition relation with count-state definitions and terminal force constraints for x; no existing DAG node is designated or defined as MAJ_n(Y).

frozen_constructor.name: GENERIC_LAYERED_GUARDED_BACKWARD_SYNTHESIS_V1
frozen_constructor.algorithm: Starting only from terminal locally forced x constants, propagate witness proofs backward through the input's deterministic layered complementary guard transitions; hash-cons identical proof nodes. No special test for majority, threshold, or reference shape is permitted.
allowed_structural_read: complementary input guard literal on each binary transition
forbidden: recognize MAJORITY and emit a counting DAG
resource increase after observing any earlier n
frozen_constructor.proof_DAG_sharing: hash-consed by (guard, true_child, false_child), with reduction when children are identical

independent_verifier.verification: Check each proof node from frozen input transition/terminal authorities and already checked children; root must cover initial state by construction.

verdict_rules.PASS_SCOPED_HOSTILE_SYNTHESIS: Candidate is independently accepted for every n in the finite series with exact total domain, valid witness proof, and frozen resource accounting.
verdict_rules.FAIL_CALCULUS_EXPRESSIVITY: A separately supplied admissible compact candidate can be shown to exist but the frozen verifier/rule forms cannot certify it. This test requires a separate preregistered witness-injection control before use.
verdict_rules.FAIL_SYNTHESIS_ACCESS: After candidate freeze, reconciliation confirms a compact certificate accepted by the same frozen verifier exists, but blind constructor failed to synthesize one without forbidden machinery.
verdict_rules.FAIL_PROOF_DAG_BLOWUP: Observed frozen construction grows beyond the preregistered resource/size criterion while a successful finite run may exist at smaller n; this is not a lower bound on all proof DAGs.
verdict_rules.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Run fails solely because the frozen resource budget is exhausted before a classified proof outcome.
verdict_rules.FAIL_DOMAIN_DROPPED: Candidate omits or totalizes a nontrivial exact domain. Not expected for total majority control, but retained for bridge taxonomy.
